args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Set-Location 'c:\Personal\Projects\LibNei\libnei-src'; $logDir='temp\regression\windows'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null; cmake --build build/windows-vs2022-release-shared --config Release --target nei_tests | Out-Host; $summary=@(); foreach($i in 1..3){ $log=Join-Path $logDir ("round_{0}.log" -f $i); $raw = (& ctest --test-dir build/windows-vs2022-release-shared -C Release --output-on-failure 2>&1 | Out-String); Set-Content -Path $log -Value $raw -Encoding UTF8; $m=[regex]::Match($raw,'(?m)^(\d+)% tests passed, (\d+) tests failed out of (\d+)'); $failed=[regex]::Matches($raw,'(?m)^\s*\d+ - (.+?) \(Failed\)$') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value.Trim() }; if($m.Success){ $summary += [pscustomobject]@{ round=$i; passed_percent=[int]$m.Groups[1].Value; failed_count=[int]$m.Groups[2].Value; total=[int]$m.Groups[3].Value; failed_tests=($failed -join '; ') } } else { $summary += [pscustomobject]@{ round=$i; passed_percent=-1; failed_count=-1; total=-1; failed_tests='PARSE_FAILED' } } }; $summaryPath=Join-Path $logDir 'summary.json'; ($summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) | Set-Content -Path $summaryPath -Encoding UTF8; Get-Content $summaryPath | Out-Host
